description.0: A longsword that once shone with the light of the very stars. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.

0.0: When the Traveler equips this, their ATK will increase by <cryo>16%</cryo> for <cryo>8</cryo>s after they hit an opponent. At the same time, they will also regenerate <cryo>3</cryo> Elemental Energy. This effect can trigger once every <cryo>5</cryo>s. This can be triggered even when the character is not on the field.

1.0: When the Traveler equips this, their CRIT DMG increases by 6% for every Element they have resonated with. Additionally, the Traveler's ATK will also increase by <cryo>20%</cryo> for 8s, and regenerate <cryo>3</cryo> Elemental Energy, after they attack and hit an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 5s. This can be triggered even when the character is not on the field.
